Uses of Class
hadur117.core.model.RobotStateLog

Packages that use RobotStateLog
Package
Description
hadur117.core.melee
Melee (free-for-all) subsystems: opponent tracking, sweep radar, minimum-risk movement, target selection, circular targeting and posture strategy, and each opponent's melee profile block (MMEM-1), driven each tick by MeleeController.
hadur117.core.model
The values the core is made of: what crosses the hexagonal boundary each tick, the robot states and their logs, and the waves the duel's gun and movement learn from.
hadur117.core.move
The duel's movement: wave surfing against the enemy's bullets, the danger views it scores with, and the shadows our own bullets cast on the enemy's waves.

    Where each simple expert aims shot at the member, in state at at its fire tick, with path the member's own track; the learned slot is NaN (its aims come from TeamDanger.aims(hadur117.core.world.EnemyShot, hadur117.core.model.RobotState)).
    (package private) MinimumRiskMovement.Wave
    TeamDodge.profile(EnemyShot s, RobotStateLog path, Point2D.Double me, List<Point2D.Double> mates, TeamDanger danger, boolean own, VirtualBullet.Aim only)
     
    (package private) void
    TeamDodge.update(List<EnemyShot> shots, RobotStateLog path, Point2D.Double me, long now, List<Point2D.Double> mates, TeamDanger danger, boolean own, VirtualBullet.Aim only)
    Profiles the shots not seen before and drops those gone past Hadur: mates where the teammates stand, own for the nearest rule, only the one aim a team whose code is read takes (or null).
    void
    MinimumRiskMovement.updateBullets(List<EnemyShot> shots, RobotStateLog myPath, Point2D.Double me, long now)
    Turns newly recorded shots into a head-on and a linear virtual bullet each, aimed at where Hadur was when they were fired, and drops the bullets that have passed Hadur (MMOVE-3).
    void
    MinimumRiskMovement.updateBullets(List<EnemyShot> shots, RobotStateLog myPath, Point2D.Double me, long now, List<Point2D.Double> mates, TeamDanger danger, boolean nearest, boolean learned)
    On a team (T6): as above, where mates are the living teammates' positions.
    void
    MinimumRiskMovement.updateBullets(List<EnemyShot> shots, RobotStateLog myPath, Point2D.Double me, long now, List<Point2D.Double> mates, TeamDanger danger, boolean nearest, boolean learned, boolean soft)
    As above, where with soft (TMODE-2) each shot's bullets weigh MinimumRiskMovement.softWeight(hadur117.core.world.EnemyShot, java.awt.geom.Point2D.Double, java.util.List<java.awt.geom.Point2D.Double>): less for each teammate nearer its shooter than Hadur was, and none under MinimumRiskMovement.SOFT_FLOOR.
    void
    MinimumRiskMovement.updateBullets(List<EnemyShot> shots, RobotStateLog myPath, Point2D.Double me, long now, List<Point2D.Double> mates, TeamDanger danger, boolean nearest, boolean learned, boolean soft, VirtualBullet.Aim only)
    As above, where with only (TMODE-21 HEADON, TMODE-22 LINEAR) each shot makes one virtual bullet, on that aim, at MinimumRiskMovement.ONE_AIM_WEIGHT: the team's code aims no other way.
    void
    MinimumRiskMovement.updateMeleeBullets(List<EnemyShot> shots, RobotStateLog myPath, Point2D.Double me, long now, List<EnemyInfo> enemies)
    Off a team: MinimumRiskMovement.updateBullets(List, RobotStateLog, Point2D.Double, long), then with MMOVE-11 each new shot's bullets weigh by the opponents nearer its shooter, and with MMOVE-13 the opponents Hadur is nearest to fire assumed shots when their guns could be cool.
    void
    MinimumRiskMovement.updateMeleeBullets(List<EnemyShot> shots, RobotStateLog myPath, Point2D.Double me, long now, List<EnemyInfo> enemies, TeamDanger danger)
    As above, where with MMOVE-15 each shot also weighs by MMOVE-11's crowd weight and a shooter whose log in danger is deep enough makes its learned aims.
